site.ogTitle: {project} - Software ne Atɛɛm Mat Faili ke Cïn Akut
site.ogDescription: Atɛɛm mat faili peer-to-peer nhom teknolojia ne nyɛn ne cïn akut. Acïn server akut. Acïn ke tök ke ben rëëc.

hero.description: Nhom teknolojia ne nyɛn ne cïn akut. Acïn server akut. Acïn ke tök ke ben rëëc.

about.title: Yic
about.intro: {project} ee platifɔɔm ke amääth ne atɛɛm mat faili peer-to-peer kɔ cak nhom teknolojia ne nyɛn ne cïn akut. Een mat interface yic ke pël ne raan ago këëkic ke cïn akut tɛɛn, ke gam atɛɛm mat data ne malëu ku ne ŋɔt ke ke cïn ke tëër ne mën akut tök. Projek kuɛŋ ee open source, ke gɛm tɛn yï {license}.

decentralized.title: Netwak ke cïn akut tɛɛn
decentralized.description: Acïn server akut, acïn ke tök ke ben rëëc. Kɔc ke yithic ku lɔr piny gam ne ke kɔŋ rot, ke cïn ŋic indekser, tracker, walaa database akut tök.

accessControl.title: Wëëŋ atɛɛk yic
accessControl.description: Raan ɣɔɔt acuk gɔɔk netwak de gup ne mëdɛn ne lëkic de gup. Ne netwak ɣɔɔt, lɔɔk ke yik kɔc: muur, admin, raan jam, moderator ku raan lɔr piny. Wëëŋ yic ne raan kee jam, moderate ku lɔr piny ke.

ui.title: Interface raan ke nhom
ui.description: Interface media center ne path ku ne mat, kɔ cak ne desktop, TV ku platifɔɔm telepɔn. Ŋet ke pël ne keyboard, mouse, gamepad walaa kontrol mac. Kɔc ke ŋic apɛi acuk lɔɔr software keic file server ke cïn nhom ne command-line interface.

dataFormat.title: Bën data ne kuɛŋ ee raan
dataFormat.description: Bën data LISH ee gɔɔk nhom JSON, ke yï pël ne gɔɔk, kuɛŋ ku ŋic. Mat ke yï ne metadata yic ku diɛr, raan ɣɔɔt acuk tëëm pël.

security.title: Pɛr ku malëu
security.description: Wën peer-to-peer ɣɔɔt ee enkrypted, ago data du ee tɔɔŋ pɛr nyin lɔɔŋ. Kɔc acuk thiɛɛŋ ne thïï VPN ne dɛ thar pɛr piɔlic. {project} ee tëëm pɛr du nhom ye cak.

crossPlatform.title: Cross-platform
crossPlatform.description: Software ee tɔɔŋ ne Windows, Linux ku macOS. Lɔɔr ne ke ɣɔɔt ne nyɛɛr.

download.title: Lɔr piny
download.description: Yök {project} de platifɔɔm du. Lɔr piny ɣɔɔt ee free ku open source.
